about: Dated notes shown on the Briefs screen. A brief is added only when the owner says so, never automatically with an update. Each brief: id (unique, never reused), date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, body (short; a blank line starts a new paragraph), optional action {label, page} for a button that opens a page such as settings. Newest date first; adding one makes the 'N new briefs' box appear for everyone who has not seen it.

briefs.title: Pin on a globe or a map
briefs.body: Drop your pin on a spinning globe instead of the flat map. Tap a region to zoom, then tap again to pin.
